統"Oh. What is it? Something happened?"
Kageaki"Subaru ji. No. She woke a little while ago. I thought my sitting beside her might disturb her rest."
統"Achha, good. Not started waving things about, has she?"
Kageaki"She is calm. Perhaps only because she has not yet grasped the situation..."
統"Well, she can't wave a sword around in that state. Warrior or no warrior."
Kageaki"She has no sword-armor with her either."
統"They say a true-forged sword-armor heals its master's wounds even when she isn't armored. A mass-produced one can't, I suppose. Good luck or bad? Depends which side you ask."
Kageaki"Had she used the sword-armor's power, I could never have resisted her in the first place."
統"Then good luck it is. Hamari taraf se, at least—from our side."
統"...Still, a warrior, and she comes to fight without her armor? Ajeeb shauk hai. What a peculiar taste."
Kageaki"No. At the root, she is simply a fighter."
統"Hm?"
Kageaki"She does not accept massacre・・. The sword is for combat・・ only."
統"...Hmm. Saw something, did you, beta?"
Kageaki"...Ji. I believe I saw what was there to be seen."
統"So what will you do with that girl?"
Kageaki"As soon as she can be moved, I will deliver her to the camp on the mountain. With her sword-armor near, she should recover faster. That seems best."
統"You're fine with that?"
Kageaki"Yes."
統"Okay. Then do that."

It had to be done.
Just as I had rejected his proposal the previous night as a samurai.

As a samurai.

What was a samurai?
—A being who ruled the people through armed force.

Rule through force. Protect through force. Take through force.
That was the samurai.

It did not mean—
a person who lived by <ruby>depending upon the kindness<rt>・・・</rt></ruby> of the people.

The previous night, he offered fields in which we might live.

He extended mercy.
He extended goodwill.

Therefore, I could not accept. Depending upon the people's generosity was not the path of the samurai.

I could accept a life of plunder, hated, despised, and condemned by the people. That was one path of the samurai: the lowest and basest, yet still within the form of samurai existence.

One could fall into banditry and remain a samurai.
But if I accepted the hand he extended, I would cease to be one.

I could no longer remain a samurai.

At the final fraction, I succeeded in cradling my sister's head. With both hands—as quickly as possible, as gently as possible—I supported a neck that now surely had no more strength than a healthy person's little finger.

With no skill or trick, I simply asked.
I prostrated myself and begged.

Nothing else remained. Argument was impossible because the conclusion already existed.

The interests of the town and her people could not be reconciled. They were not beings moved only by material interest.

They were samurai.
People founded upon armed force.

If they wished to remain samurai within this town, then indeed no road existed except occupying the mountain and living as thieves. Expelled from a regular army, what other form could they take?

The conclusion existed.
Therefore, I <ruby>begged<rt>・・</rt></ruby>.

If one wished to force through something that did not follow reason, then one begged and requested. That was the single path.

Bend your principle.
Discard the samurai.
